title: Greedy Decoding Is Not Precision-Invariant: Cross-Precision Output Divergence in LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2609.26621v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Greedy decoding from large language models is commonly treated as deterministic. We show it is not precision-invariant: the same model, prompt, and decoding algorithm produce different outputs in BF16 versus FP16 on identical hardware. Across our evaluations of six models (1.1B-7B parameters, four families; divergence additionally characterised at 12B) and three benchmarks, 49-100\% of prompts diverge; a single token flip often cascades into trajectory-level divergence. We develop an empirical error-propagation analysis and find that 22 layers of accumulated body error do not distinguish flipping from non-flipping steps; the outcome depends primarily on the top-two logit margin at the LM head relative to the directional perturbation between the top-two candidates. The analysis makes five testable predictions about intervention outcomes, including that applying more FP32 compute (broader scope) makes agreement worse. The experiments match

translated_title: 贪心解码并非精度不变：大语言模型推理中的跨精度输出分歧
translated_abstract: 大语言模型的贪心解码通常被视为确定性的。我们证明它并非精度不变：相同的模型、提示词和解码算法，在同一硬件上使用BF16与FP16会产生不同的输出。在我们对六个模型（1.1B至7B参数，涵盖四个模型家族；另在12B模型上对分歧进行了额外表征）和三个基准的评估中，49-100%的提示词出现分歧；单个token的翻转常常会级联导致轨迹层面的分歧。我们开展了实证误差传播分析，发现22层累积的主体误差无法区分翻转步骤与非翻转步骤；结果主要取决于LM head处前两名logit的差距相对于前两名候选之间方向性扰动的关系。该分析提出了关于干预结果的五个可检验预测，其中包括施加更多FP32计算（更广的范围）反而会使一致性变差。实验结果与……相符（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文发现大语言模型的贪心解码并非精度不变——同一模型与提示在BF16和FP16下会因单个token翻转级联而产生不同输出，且分歧结果主要由LM head处前两名logit差距与候选间方向性扰动的关系决定。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that greedy decoding in LLMs is not precision-invariant—the same model and prompt diverge between BF16 and FP16 as single token flips cascade into trajectory-level divergence, with outcomes governed primarily by the top-two logit margin at the LM head relative to the directional perturbation between candidates.
